headline_marked: France protests: [[Bangladeshi-owned shops looted]] in Paris
headline: France protests: Bangladeshi-owned shops looted in Paris
summary: Expatriate Bangladeshi business owners in Paris are in fear as ongoing protests over cost of living spark widespread vandalism and looting of their stores.
details: Ongoing protests in France over the rising cost of living, fuel prices, and educational issues have led to widespread vandalism and looting of various establishments.
In Paris, several businesses owned by expatriate Bangladeshis have been targeted. One mobile phone and electronics shop owner, Hasan, reported losing goods worth approximately 90,000 euros.

Bangladeshi entrepreneurs operating money transfer and exchange outlets, such as Ria and MoneyGram, are particularly concerned as these locations have been frequent targets of looting in previous protests.
According to Paris city authorities, 451 shops were vandalized in the city alone between October 17 and 18, while thousands of businesses nationwide have been affected.

Beyond business owners, food delivery workers and daily wage laborers are facing severe hardships. Increased police presence and strict document checks have made it difficult for them to work and move safely.
The French government has deployed approximately 70,000 police and gendarmerie members nationwide to restore order and prevent further violence.
Local business associations and the Chamber of Commerce and Industry are offering support, including help with insurance claims and administrative assistance for affected owners.
The French government is also providing financial aid, including interest-free loans up to 50,000 euros and special funds for eligible small businesses to help them recover.

headline: Sajek Valley deserted as road blockade sparks violence
summary: The popular tourist hub in Rangamati has been shut down by local administration following clashes and a reported gunfight, leading to mass cancellations of resort bookings.
details: Sajek Valley in Rangamati has become a ghost town after the local administration shut it down following clashes and a reported gunfight during a road blockade on Thursday.
caption:
A popular tourist paradise turned ghost town. Sajek Valley is deserted as clashes and a reported gunfight leave the area in a state of panic.

Sajek Valley in Rangamati has become a ghost town after the local administration shut it down following clashes and a reported gunfight during a road blockade on Thursday.
